title: Room-scoped Cinema authority, not a public LiveKit token endpoint
$comment: GET /rooms/:id/cinema returns CinemaState under final room/18+/member fence. POST cinema/start|join uses start, source requires actual SFU screen video+audio, stop binds current scope. POST media/leases/:leaseId/renew|release uses leaseMutation. Four RTC paths require current protected lease, room cookie, same-origin and JWT; no direct SFU HTTP/admin exposure. Start/join replay cannot reactivate retired lease. Lease20s/renew5s, API/SFU boot epochs, protected authority excluded from DB rollback. API loss watchdog<=5s, explicit stop acknowledges confirmed server cutoff only. New media-v3 delivery is separate from signed0.0.1. Exact profile and rollback: P09_MEDIA.md/ADR036.
